title:
The {@link Workflow.MlPipeline.Rdce} optimization eliminates every pair of redundant {@link`Data} conversions in an
{@link MlPipeline} workflow. Specifically, this optimization replaces every pair of
{@link MlAtomicPipe#convertNativeToPipeOutputs} and {@link MlAtomicPipe#convertPipeInputsToNative} actions with a
single {@link MlAtomicPipe#convertNativeToNative} action.
For example, if we have the following workflow:
```
beforeDoAfterProcess ---------- convertNativeToPipeOutputs \
                                                            \
                                                             --- convertPipeInputsToNative --- beforeAndDoTrain
                                                            /
beforeDoAfterProcess ---------- convertNativeToPipeOutputs /
```
{@link Workflow.MlPipeline.Rdce#optimize} will produce the following workflow:
```
beforeDoAfterProcess \
                      \
                       --- convertNativeToNative --- beforeAndDoTrain
                      /
beforeDoAfterProcess /
```
Currently, {@link Workflow.MlPipeline.Rdce} will not optimize a pair of conversions if the following conditions are present:
- The {@link MlAtomicPipe#convertPipeInputsToNative} action has a `x` or `y` input port with an incoming edge
  from a vertex that is not a {@link Workflow.Action} or is not a {@link MlAtomicPipe#convertNativeToPipeOutputs}
  action.
